In your randomized run, Tate & Liza actually use a Fire-type team, so you'll want Water and Ground-types like Carvanha or Spheal [1].

### Top picks

#### Carvanha (core)
* **Where:** Route 118 or 119 (Super Rod, Levels 20-45, 100% on Route 119) [2]
* **When to catch:** Available right now.
* **Why it helps now:** Tate & Liza's randomized team consists entirely of Fire-types (Camerupt, Torkoal, Magcargo, Houndoom) [1]. Sharpedo is a fast glass cannon that can hit them all super-effectively with Water-type moves like Surf [3][4]. *(Note: Crunch and Surf are special in Gen III, but Sharpedo has a usable Sp. Atk of 95).*
* **Long run:** Sharpedo remains excellent against Elite Four Phoebe with its Dark typing and Crunch [3][4]. It will stay useful through the endgame as a fast cleaner.
* **Backup:** None.

#### Spheal (core)
* **Where:** Shoal Cave b1f/b2f/high-tide (Walk, Levels 26-32, 50%) [5]
* **When to catch:** Available right now.
* **Why it helps now:** As a Water/Ice-type, Spheal (and its evolution Sealeo) has excellent bulk to take hits from Tate & Liza's Fire-types while hitting back hard with Surf [6].
* **Long run:** Walrein is one of the best Ice-types in the game, making it incredibly valuable against Elite Four Drake and the Champion [7].
* **Backup:** **Shuppet** (situational) - Found on Mt. Pyre (Walk, Levels 22-29, 100%) [8]. If you need a strong physical attacker, Banette hits incredibly hard, though it won't have type advantage over the Fire gym [9]. It offers excellent Ghost-type physical damage in the long run but is frail defensively.

---

### Key Battles

#### Mossdeep Gym: Tate & Liza
Because your run is randomized, Tate & Liza have a Fire-type team (Camerupt, Torkoal, Magcargo, Houndoom) spanning levels 41-42 [1]. Their typical Psychic strategies are gone, so hit them with Water and Ground-type moves instead [1].

---

### Rules I followed
* None (a normal run).

### Assumptions
* Your party is underleveled for the level 41-42 Gym battle and will require some grinding.
* Marshtomp will evolve into Swampert at level 36, greatly helping in this battle.

### To sharpen this
* Do you plan to evolve Marshtomp to Swampert before taking on Tate & Liza?
